name: RG20262
tagline: Grand cast iron presence with panoramic fire views
description: The CJ-30 is an imported cast iron masterpiece designed for high-output heating and a commanding aesthetic. This versatile unit can be installed as a sleek built-in insert or as a freestanding centerpiece on a custom plinth. Featuring advanced secondary and tertiary air systems, it ensures an exceptionally clean and efficient burn. Its expansive heat-resistant glass door provides a panoramic view of the flames, while the heavy-duty Australian mineral ore construction guarantees long-lasting heat retention and durability for the largest living spaces.
features: Heavy-duty cast iron construction for maximum heat storage
Panoramic ceramic glass window with air-wash technology
Advanced secondary and tertiary air systems for clean combustion
Removable internal ash drawer for easy maintenance
